stories.title: Many Iranians are heading to Turkey to escape the ongoing war's heavy toll
stories.description: Iranians visiting the city of Van, Turkey, near the Iranian border say how expensive and difficult life back home is.

stories.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
stories.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

stories.title: Houthis reportedly kill six in first deadly attack since start of Iran war

stories.title: Israel strikes south Lebanon after two soldiers killed by explosion
stories.description: Lebanese authorities says one person was killed in the strikes, which came after the first Israeli military fatalities in Lebanon in more than a month.

stories.title: Iranian footballers who defied Tehran become Australian citizens
stories.description: There were among seven to be granted humanitarian visas while playing in Australia - but the other five changed their minds and returned to Iran.

stories.title: Iran says deal with Oman on Strait of Hormuz is in final stages

stories.title: US aircraft carrier expected to relieve USS Lincoln in Middle East

stories.title: Is China seeking to copy Iran’s Strait of Hormuz blockade around Taiwan?
stories.description: Taiwan has long prepared for a Chinese military invasion but wars in Iran and Ukraine expose new potential threats.
